note: McPherson County (SD) publishes its zoning ordinance (24-1, amendments 25-2, 25-3) as PDF documents only. The county GIS portal at gis.districtiii.org/MCPHERSON is an ArcGIS web viewer; searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the District III host found only a parcel layer (MCPHERSON_COUNTY_LAYERS2 parcels, not reachable by REST probe) and no zoning district polygon service. No queryable zoning district layer was found for the county or its towns (Leola, Eureka).
